invalid_requirement.why: set_requirement refused a proposal that is not one closed, versioned predicate (unknown kind or key, a field no bound may cover, a missing component, a bad op or value). Nothing was recorded; the assistant asks the user again.

requirement_unit_mismatch.why: set_requirement refused a bound with no unit or a unit other than the field's stored unit, before any card. Nothing was recorded; the message names the stored unit so the assistant asks the user again.

requirement_contradicts.why: set_requirement refused a bound whose range does not meet an active requirement on the same component and field (or a second kept horizon). Nothing was recorded; the assistant asks which one holds.

requirement_not_found.why: set_requirement named a requirement id to replace or retire that is not active on this conversation. Nothing changed.

requirement_thread_required.why: set_requirement was called from a session with no durable conversation (a harness run's own session, or a chat with no saved project). Requirements live only on the user's conversation; nothing was recorded.

requirement_violated.why: An assistant edit would break a requirement the user confirmed (a bound or the kept model horizon), or could not show its effect on one. It was refused at dispatch before any card; nothing was written. The message names the requirement; the assistant asks the user whether to change the edit or the requirement. Manual edits are never refused.

requirement_check_unavailable.why: The confirmed requirements could not be read or evaluated when an assistant edit was dispatched, so the edit was refused (fail closed); nothing was written.
